title: Split manifest row
description: SEAM 1. One row of data/splits/split_manifest.csv, the single source of truth for which image belongs to which split. Produced by Member 1 (scripts/prepare_data.py); consumed by Members 2, 3 and 4 through edgecnn.data.build_dataloaders. The CSV header itself is checked by edgecnn.contracts.schema.MANIFEST_COLUMNS; this document validates the values in each row.

relative_path.description: Path to the image relative to outputs.processed_dir. POSIX forward slashes only - the team runs on both Windows and Linux and a backslash here makes the manifest machine-specific.

label_index.description: Integer class label. Must satisfy 0 <= label_index < num_classes and must agree with the position of label_name in split_meta.json.class_names. This ordering is frozen once the manifest is committed; every confusion matrix is indexed by it.

label_name.description: Human-readable class name, e.g. 'AnnualCrop'. Must equal split_meta.json.class_names[label_index].

split.description: Which split this image belongs to. Assignment mandates 70/15/15. Rows marked 'test' must not be read by any training code - see TrainerProtocol.
